recipe.base: one edible item with valid food component
recipe.addition: one rarity material resolved via Apotheosis RarityRegistry material map
recipe.template: custom reusable monk-related template, optional, not yet decided
recipe.output: one item preserving base food and its properties, with an attached one-use infused-rarity marker
recipe.stacking: no infusion stacking; no re-infusing already treated food
recipe.food_identity: original food registry id, not a new food identity
recipe.grants_mastery_xp: only if consumed by a Monk; award after successful server-confirmed consumption
recipe.first_time_food_bonus: separate one-time discovery bonus; infusion does not reset or duplicate it
recipe.note: The material is consumed at crafting; one infused food is consumed once. Do not award XP on crafting.

test_gates: ingredient resolution from pinned runtime rarity registry
crafting consume exactly one rarity material
keep other food effects/nutrition and required containers
don't grant XP for a recipe or partial/cancelled meal
no double-dipping for re-infused food or stack splitting
prevent automation/dupe exploits and unauthorized cheap rarity material routes
verify edible items can be processed by one custom smithing recipe
